instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. Indoors against a plain white wall, the blonde woman in the beige hoodie (R2) on the left and the dark-haired woman in the orange hoodie (R1) on the right face forward. They high-five with their raised hands while jointly holding a yellow sign that reads "WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS" at waist level. Both women are smiling warmly at the camera. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft, diffused studio lighting with a neutral color palette.
elements: R1 is the dark-haired woman in the orange hoodie raising a hand to high-five R2
R2 is the blonde woman in the beige hoodie raising a hand to meet R1's high-five
R1 and R2 face forward while their raised hands meet in a high-five
R1 and R2 jointly hold a yellow sign at waist level
The sign reads "WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS"
The scene is indoors against a plain white wall
